title: Double-Grant on Priority Pointer Rollover
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=4'b1001 — two masters granted simultaneously
rtl: assign gnt = req & {last_gnt[0] ? 4'hF : 4'h0};  // Mask is wrong at rollover
expected_root_cause: The priority mask expression ({last_gnt[0] ? 4'hF : 4'h0}) does not correctly implement round-robin rotation; at the rollover boundary two masters simultaneously satisfy the mask condition producing a non-one-hot grant.
description: At the rollover boundary (last_gnt=3 → 0) both master 3 and master 0 are simultaneously granted for one cycle because the combinational mask straddles the boundary incorrectly.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=4'b1001 — two masters granted simultaneously
success_log: gnt is always one-hot. No simultaneous grants detected.
